title: CML-07 S2 Identity Artifact Types v1

decision_boundary.rule: One interaction may select six independent Artifact Type admission requests; no type identity, schema, or authority is merged.

decision_requests.requested_effect: Admit the exact cal.artifact-type.product-identity/v1 candidate contract and its bound schema as an independently governed Artifact Type.
Admit the exact cal.artifact-type.project-identity/v1 candidate contract and its bound schema as an independently governed Artifact Type.
Admit the exact cal.artifact-type.method-binding/v1 candidate contract and its bound schema as an independently governed Artifact Type.
Admit the exact cal.artifact-type.goal/v1 candidate contract and its bound schema as an independently governed Artifact Type.
Admit the exact cal.artifact-type.identity-graph/v1 candidate contract and its bound schema as an independently governed Artifact Type.
Admit the exact cal.artifact-type.identity-lineage/v1 candidate contract and its bound schema as an independently governed Artifact Type.

transaction_model.effect: A future exact decision may mark only the six bound Artifact Type candidates admitted-current; no candidate file is rewritten.

rollback_policy: Because admission is a decision overlay with no live postimage write, failure before the complete decision and evidence package exists has zero admission effect. A partial decision package must be removed or marked failed and cannot be interpreted as admission.
excluded_effects: No candidate Artifact Type, schema, fixture, or receipt byte is rewritten.
No S3 Product, Project, Method Binding, Goal, Identity Graph, or Identity Lineage instance is materialized or admitted.
No identity-contract, implementation, or runtime conformance is claimed.
No commit, push, publication, deployment, or stable release is authorized.
claim_ceiling: A PASS bundle is eligible for one exact digest-bound artifact-type-owner decision admitting six separate S2 Artifact Type contracts. It does not itself admit a type, execute S3, establish identity-contract, implementation, or runtime conformance, or grant publication authority.
